t: A pocket ESP32-S3 camera board with a screen, motion sensor, and microphone.
steps: Buy the board from the LILYGO store or LILYGO on Tindie. Pick the normal, fisheye, or 5 MP camera.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the ESP32 board package.
Download the examples from the LILYGO T-Camera S3 GitHub page.
Check your board revision. Version 1.7 needs its own setting in the code.
Connect the board with a USB-C cable and upload the camera server example.
Join the board's Wi-Fi network and open the stream in a web browser.
Try the QR code reader example next.
Turn off the charging check in the power chip code before you add a battery.
